Vendored from https://github.com/riscv-software-src/riscv-tests
Commit: 2ebecad997fa58cd9e5724340ba75aa4b59bd1d0

Files included, untouched from upstream:
  isa/rv32ui/*.S              (42 files - RV32 user-mode integer test wrappers)
  isa/rv64ui/*.S               (shared test bodies rv32ui includes; 54 files)
  isa/macros/scalar/test_macros.h   (the real, per-instruction test-vector macros)
  env/p/link.ld                (from the riscv/riscv-test-env submodule, real and unmodified)
  LICENSE                      (upstream's own license, BSD-style)

NOT vendored: env/p/riscv_test.h - upstream's pass/fail signaling harness
requires privileged-mode CSRs/traps/mret that are provably unneeded to test
RV32I integer instruction correctness (see ../../harness/env/p/riscv_test.h
and docs/SCOPE.md for the full reasoning). A simplified drop-in replacement
lives at ../../harness/env/p/riscv_test.h - clearly marked there as this
project's own work, not upstream content.
